# group-theory-lib

> Clean-slate exact abstract algebra, finite group theory, linear algebra, and off-heap FFM numerical computing for Java 25 LTS (`module lock14.algebra`).

## Overview

`lock14/group-theory-lib` (3.0) is a zero-runtime-dependency Java 25 LTS library (`requires java.base` only) built on a dual-layer architecture combining Haskell/Scala-style algebraic typeclasses (`lock14.algebra.structure`) with F-bounded fluent elements (`lock14.algebra.element`). Every `Group`, `Ring`, `IntegralDomain`, `EuclideanDomain`, `DivisionRing`, and `Field` implementation is 100% mathematically exact, while IEEE-754 floating-point approximations and Foreign Function & Memory (`Arena`) matrices live in `lock14.algebra.numeric`.

## Quick Start

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>lock14</groupId>
  <artifactId>group-theory-lib</artifactId>
  <version>3.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
</dependency>
```

```java
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import lock14.algebra.group.*;
import lock14.algebra.linear.*;
import lock14.algebra.numbers.*;
import lock14.algebra.quotient.*;

// 1. Quotient group S_4 / V_4 (order 6) & Burnside's lemma
SymmetricGroup s4 = new SymmetricGroup(4);
Subgroup<Permutation> v4 = Subgroup.of(s4, Set.of(
    Permutation.identity(4),
    Permutation.fromCycles(4, List.of(List.of(0, 1), List.of(2, 3))),
    Permutation.fromCycles(4, List.of(List.of(0, 2), List.of(1, 3))),
    Permutation.fromCycles(4, List.of(List.of(0, 3), List.of(1, 2)))
));
QuotientGroup<Permutation> q = QuotientGroup.of(s4, v4);

// 2. AES Rijndael Galois field GF(2^8) = F_2[x] / (x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x + 1)
var gf256 = GaloisFields.extension(2, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1);

// 3. Exact rational linear system solve & RREF nullspace basis
SquareMatrix<Rational> a = SquareMatrix.of(2, Rationals.FIELD,
    Rational.of(1), Rational.of(2),
    Rational.of(3), Rational.of(4));
Vector<Rational> x = a.solve(Vector.of(Rationals.FIELD, Rational.of(5), Rational.of(11)));
```

## Core Typeclasses (`lock14.algebra.structure`)

- `Magma<T>` -> `Semigroup<T>` -> `Monoid<T>` -> `Group<T>` -> `AbelianGroup<T>` / `FiniteGroup<T>`: Single-operation hierarchy with binary `power`, `Collector`, and Java 25 `Gatherer` prefix scans (`scanGatherer()`).
- `Semiring<T>` -> `Ring<T>` -> `CommutativeRing<T>` -> `IntegralDomain<T>` -> `EuclideanDomain<T>` -> `Field<T>`: Ring hierarchy with `divRem`, `gcd`, and Bézout `extendedGcd`.
- `DivisionRing<T>`: Potentially non-commutative skew-fields (`tryReciprocal`, `reciprocal`) unifying `QuaternionDivisionRing` and `Field`.
- `LeftModule<M, R>` -> `VectorSpace<V, F>`: Scalar-action structures over rings and fields.
- `DirectProduct`, `Pair<A, B>`, `GroupHomomorphism<A, B>`, `RingHomomorphism<A, B>`: Universal product constructions and structure-preserving maps.

## Exported JPMS Packages (`module lock14.algebra`)

- `lock14.algebra.structure`: Exact algebraic typeclasses, homomorphisms, and direct products.
- `lock14.algebra.element`: Self-typed fluent element contracts (`GroupElement`, `RingElement`, `DivisionRingElement`, `FieldElement`, `ModuleElement`).
- `lock14.algebra.exceptions`: Unchecked domain exceptions (`AlgebraException`, `NonInvertibleElementException`, `IncompatibleAlgebraException`, `DimensionMismatchException`, `UndefinedOperationException`).
- `lock14.algebra.group`: `Permutation`, `SymmetricGroup`, `AlternatingGroup`, `CyclicGroup`, `DihedralGroup`, `Subgroup`, `Coset`, `QuotientGroup`, and `GroupAction` (orbits, stabilizers, Burnside's lemma).
- `lock14.algebra.numbers`: `Integers` (canonical least-non-negative Euclidean Z), `Rational` / `Rationals` (Q), `Complex<T>`, `ComplexRing<T>`, `GaussianIntegers` (Euclidean Z[i]), `ComplexField<T>` (Q(i)), `Quaternion<T>`, `QuaternionRing<T>`, and `QuaternionDivisionRing<T>` (H(Q)).
- `lock14.algebra.polynomial`: `Polynomial<T>`, `PolynomialRing<T>`, `NonCommutativePolynomialRing<T>`, and `PolynomialEuclideanDomain<T>` (monic long division, GCD, Horner evaluation, derivatives).
- `lock14.algebra.quotient`: Universal Euclidean quotients `Residue<T>`, `QuotientRing<T>`, `QuotientField<T>`, `ZMod` (Z/nZ and F_p), and Rabin-verified `GaloisFields` (`GF(p^k)`).
- `lock14.algebra.linear`: Sealed `Matrix<T>` (`SquareMatrix<T>`, `RectangularMatrix<T>`), `Vector<T>`, `CoordinateModule<T>`, `CoordinateVectorSpace<T>`, `MatrixRing<T>`, `RrefResult<T>` (`rref`, `rank`, `nullity`, `kernel`), and `LuDecomposition<T>` (`lu`, `solve`, `inverse`, `tryInverse`, `determinant`).
- `lock14.algebra.numeric`: `NumericContext` (`ScopedValue` `EPSILON` & `MATH_CONTEXT`), `ApproximateField<T>`, `Float64Field`, `Complex64`, `Quaternion64` (SLERP & 3D rotations), and off-heap FFM `Arena`-backed `Float64Matrix`.

## Key Design Invariants

- **Exact Equality:** Core algebraic structures never use approximate floating-point tolerances; `equals` and `hashCode` reflect canonical mathematical equivalence (reduced rationals, trimmed polynomials, canonical cosets, least-non-negative Euclidean remainders).
- **Explicit Parent Ownership:** Modular and parameterized elements carry their parent structure directly and throw `IncompatibleAlgebraException` on cross-modulus/cross-ring arithmetic.
- **Zero-Copy Encapsulation:** Backing arrays are never exposed directly; public factories validate and copy inputs while internal operations use package-private zero-copy constructors.
- **Total & Throwing Inverses:** Partial inversions offer both `Optional`-returning `tryReciprocal` / `tryInverse` and `NonInvertibleElementException`-throwing `reciprocal` / `inverse`.
